description: Run one suite for one production script, both scoped to run://: the suite starts as its own process in this checkout, given the script when it is a general test, and its tests report themselves to testicle.set as every suite does. testicle, a test's title, runs the suite up to that test, the tests before it with it (the reporter's --test); left out, the whole suite. Answered at once with {started: true}, not waiting for the suite. Refused not-a-production-script, not-a-suite or no-such-file.
